selection: Jointly select model parameters, High weight and threshold using pooled inner out-of-fold F2; ties by higher precision, recall, higher threshold, then stable grid order. F2 = 5TP/(5TP+4FN+FP). Also report the same fitted model at threshold .5, not a separately tuned .5 model. Blend endpoints retain their prior High-MAE tuning; tune only its warning threshold by inner F2, retaining fixed 50/50 mixing. Also report score threshold 4.
validation: Five stratified outer folds repeated with the five original seeds; four stratified inner folds. New splits differ from prior regression and three-class runs. All classifiers and the refitted blend share these splits. Preprocessing, weights, endpoint tuning and warning thresholds use training data only. Inner tuning reuses inner predictions; only outer scores assess the full procedure.
interpretation: High >=4 versus Below-high <4 are study-defined score groups, not clinical diagnoses or no-risk claims. Probabilities are uncalibrated model outputs, especially under sample weighting. No synthetic data, additional survey features, BAT predictors, independent validation or deployment model. This follows repeated inspection of these 97 students and is exploratory.
